diagnosis: The institutional trading RFQ namespace exposes private market quotes and counterparties across the Redis adapter. The connection middleware checks general trader token validity, but does not verify that the trader's institution is an authorized participant in the RFQ identified in socket.nsp.name, allowing rival trading desks to front-run institutional orders.

Namespace: /markets/rfq-swap-jpm-9912
Trader-Token: Bearer <competing_hedge_fund_jwt>
